scope: FieldLog §21.2 local account service only, with disposable synthetic accounts

observations: Pinned ordinary sign-in, confirmation, sign-out, expiry, static sync and recovery suites passed against the deletion backend. Strict patch reversal restored the recovered backend blob.

The new route was unavailable on the recovered backend and in static mode. The deletion backend rejected implicit, malformed, oversized, wrong-host, expired, pending, cross-account and wrong-scope requests with the database unchanged.
A trigger aborted the final receipt insert. The request returned 503 and every account, auth, sync and receipt row matched the pre-request snapshot.

The client received RemoteDisconnected before response headers after the commit. The deleted account had zero remaining service rows, the other account rows matched byte for byte, and SQLite foreign_key_check was clean.
The identical request returned the scoped receipt after listener restart. Altered credentials, identity, scope or key failed, and deleted sessions, proofs and approvals lost their prior access.
The other account retained session, task and entry replay, sign-in approval and recovery access. Replaying the old deletion after reprovisioning the same identifiers left the new session active.

custody.transport: Pinned isolated-loopback adaptation. The replay's in-process servers bind 127.0.0.1 on OS-assigned ports while clients and servers preserve the fixed account HTTP authority.
custody.listeners: The replay shut down every owned server, joined every listener thread, closed each listener, and observed connection refusal at each bound port.
custody.children: The replay's bounded Git and operator CLI subprocess calls returned before the replay exited successfully. No standalone server process was launched.
custody.scratch: The replay verified removal of its TemporaryDirectory. The preparatory reconstruction directory was removed after its command exited successfully.
custody.excluded: Actual data, native and device work, production and external provider work, and historical held resources.

pending: Native intent, receipt handling and local cleanup integration belong to the app lane.

independentResults: Existing account, recovery, task, and entry regressions passed.
Aborted receipt insertion left all scoped rows intact.
Lost reply recovered the exact receipt after restart.
One account was removed and the other account's rows stayed equal.
Reprovisioning the same identifiers remained active after retrying the old completed request.
rootReview.scope: Source inspection and independent HTTP/SQLite verification with disposable synthetic accounts.
